description: This file contains unit tests for a project scaffolding and initialization system, specifically testing the DotNetTemplate and related project setup functionality.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration data for the project being initialized.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration for different project types, such as DOTNET.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Contains initialization info for templates, including commands and configuration.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class for initializing projects based on templates and configurations.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides template files from a specified directory.

classes.name: DotNetTemplate
classes.description: Template class for generating and setting up .NET projects.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the initialization of a project from template, verifying output files and content.

methods.name: test_dotnet_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks retrieval of init info from DotNetTemplate, ensuring commands and URLs are correct.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Verifies that the post-processing scripts run and produce expected side effects.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests loading of project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures template variables within files are correctly replaced during project initialization.
